_comment: Synthetic tplot dataclass recording mimicking pyspedas.dscovr.mag output for the Gannon week (2024-05-10). Times are Unix epoch seconds (UTC), y is a (n,3) array of [Bx, By, Bz] in GSE coordinates (nT). Values track the dramatic IMF southward turning during the G5 storm: Bz drops from ~-15 nT pre-shock to ~-50 nT at peak intensity around 22:00 UTC May 10. This is the canonical southward-IMF signature that drove the geomagnetic storm.
